title: Hazel and the Bakery
author: Isandro Galloway
blurb: Sable Montrose, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
